## Download and install

- **Apple Silicon (M1 or later):** choose the `arm64.dmg` download.
- **Intel Mac:** choose the `x64.dmg` download.
- Open the DMG, drag Machete into Applications, then eject the disk image.
- ZIP downloads are also available. Quit Machete before replacing an older copy.
- The `.sha256` files contain checksums for the matching DMG and ZIP downloads.

## macOS permissions

These builds are ad-hoc signed and are **not notarized by Apple**. macOS may
block the first launch. If you trust this download, follow
[Apple’s instructions for opening an app from an unidentified developer](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445).

For Double Shift and selected-text capture, enable Machete under **System
Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility**. A new ad-hoc build may require
granting permission again. Developer ID signing and notarization are not part of
these builds.
